Class UnifiedNeutralBiodiversityEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.UnifiedNeutralBiodiversityEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class UnifiedNeutralBiodiversityEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Hubbell's Unified Neutral Theory of Biodiversity & Biogeography (UNTB) Engine.

Formalizes Stephen P. Hubbell's Unified Neutral Theory of Biodiversity and Biogeography (Hubbell 2001, Princeton University Press; Volkov et al. 2003, Nature; Rosindell et al. 2011, TREE).

Replaces ad-hoc scalar biodiversity indices with an analytical, order-independent zero-sum ecological drift and speciation-extinction model:

  1. Fundamental Biodiversity Number (\(\theta\)): \[ \theta = 2 J_M \nu \] where \(J_M\) is the metacommunity carrying capacity (total biomass or headcount) and \(\nu\) is the speciation/diversification rate per birth.
  2. Preston-Hubbell Species-Area Power Law: \[ S(A) = c \cdot A^z \] with canonical spatial scaling exponent \(z \approx 0.25\) across continental and insular biomes.
  3. Fisher-Volkov Relative Species Abundance (SAD): Expected number of species with \(n\) individuals: \[ \langle \phi_n \rangle = \theta \cdot \frac{x^n}{n}, \quad x = \frac{J_M}{J_M + \theta} \] Total species richness: \(S = -\theta \ln(1 - x)\).
  4. Endogenous Extinction Debt from Habitat/Biomass Depletion: When wild habitat or biomass is reduced by hunting/deforestation (\(J \to J_{\text{post}}\)): \[ \frac{S_{\text{post}}}{S_0} = \left(\frac{J_{\text{post}}}{J_0}\right)^z \]
